_comment: Regenerate the shared sections with node scripts/sync-chrome.cjs.
base prefixes cross-page anchors. asset prefixes files under assets/.
Slots capture per-page navigation, section IDs and reveal classes.
FAQ questions and answers are plain text rendered through one accordion partial.

faqs.question: Do Koels need a Kahani Player?
faqs.answer: Yes. Koels are physical story discs for the Kahani Player. If you’re new to Hey Kahani, start with the Player; if you already have one, you can add more Koels to your collection.

faqs.question: What age is Hey Kahani for?
faqs.answer: Hey Kahani is made for kids around ages 3 to 6, with stories that grow alongside them. Younger ones can listen too, with a grown-up nearby.

faqs.question: What languages do you support?
faqs.answer: Every Kahani launches in English first. More stories will come in Hindi, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Punjabi, Urdu, and Bengali, so the words and names feel familiar.

faqs.question: Do kids need a phone or tablet to listen?
faqs.answer: No. Kids listen on the Player. Grown-ups use the companion app for setup and guidance. For them, the story stays screen free.

faqs.question: How do Koels work?
faqs.answer: Each Koel is a round story disc. Kids spot the artwork, place it on the Player, and the story begins. No menus. No fuss.

faqs.question: What’s in the box?
faqs.answer: The product listing shows what is included with the Player or bundle you choose. Koels are the story discs used with the Player; check the included stories when choosing your first purchase.

faqs.question: What is the Kahani Player?
faqs.answer: A screen-free audio player for South Asian stories. Children choose a circular Koel story disc, place it on top, and listen.

faqs.answer: Each Koel is a round story disc. Children spot the artwork, place it on the Player, and the story begins. Koels need a Kahani Player.

faqs.question: What comes with my Player?
faqs.answer: The Kahani Player is the listening device. Included Koels and other box contents depend on the product or bundle you choose. Final pack contents will be listed before purchase.

faqs.question: Where can I find the hardware specifications?
faqs.answer: The physical controls, carry handle and Player appearance are shown above. Battery, charging, connectivity, dimensions and weight details are still to be confirmed.
